instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Custom furniture manufacturer crafting solid wood pieces for hospitality and high-end residential projects. Blend of CNC routing for repetitive components with traditional joinery for finishing. Evaluating digital twin assembly planning to reduce custom project lead times from 12 to 7 weeks. Multi-department organization with formalized budgets, quarterly business reviews, and a dedicated strategy function. We have invested in core systems (ERP, CRM, HRIS) but these are not always well-integrated. Innovation is a standing agenda item at board level with annual investment allocated, but execution velocity varies across business units.
answers.pastInitiatives: Our digital transformation program is in its third year with a dedicated transformation office reporting to the CEO. We have completed an ERP migration to the cloud, rolled out a company-wide data warehouse with self-service BI dashboards, and established a center of excellence for process automation using RPA and low-code tools. The program has delivered €2.4M in annualized cost savings to date.
answers.strategicGoals: Targeting 30% year-over-year top-line growth. We see untapped demand in adjacent customer segments and are evaluating whether to build, buy, or partner to accelerate market penetration. The core question is whether to deepen our vertical specialization or broaden horizontally into related product categories.
answers.teamSize: Our R&D function consists of 10-12 engineers organized into two squads: one focused on core product innovation and one on exploratory/new business model prototyping. We also have 2 dedicated data engineers building our analytics infrastructure. Innovation projects follow a lean startup methodology with clear go/no-go criteria at 3-month checkpoints.

input.changes_since_last: Completed 3 strategic partnerships. Revenue growth 10% YoY. Exploring AI/ML capabilities.

opportunities.title: Enterprise Process Standardization and Optimization
opportunities.rationale: The successful establishment of the CoE and data warehouse provides a solid foundation for process scale. This opportunity focuses on embedding governance into every workflow, ensuring that cost savings are repeatable across all newly partnered or expanded business units.

first_actions: Map end-to-end critical processes (Quote to Cash) across the three core systems (ERP, CRM, HRIS).
Design and deploy standardized approval workflows incorporating mandatory compliance checks for high-risk materials/exports.
Select 2-3 target departments for a pilot deployment of unified process models.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in process execution variance across business units by 25%
milestones: Completion of current state process mapping.
Development and testing of standardized workflows for one pilot unit.
Rollout to a second business unit.

opportunities.title: Digital Product Ecosystemization and Component Monetization
opportunities.rationale: To achieve 30% growth, Strato must move beyond selling pure custom services. By digitizing standardized components and creating a modular marketplace (digital twin blue-prints), the company can dramatically increase throughput and reduce project lead time dependency on manual labor.

first_actions: Identify 5-7 core product components that are frequently customized but have stable design parameters.
Develop a standardized digital component catalog (CAD/BIM) linked to pricing and regulatory compliance data.
Pilot the sale of these pre-packaged, compliant blueprints through an online portal.
execution_plan.success_metric: Percentage of total revenue derived from standardized components vs. custom services.
milestones: Completion and validation of the core component digital catalog.
Beta launch of the internal blueprint ordering system.
Formal market testing with 1-2 strategic partners.

next_steps.action: Formalize the strategy decision (Build vs. Buy vs. Partner) for horizontal expansion into adjacent product categories.
Establish clear KPIs and operational guidelines for integrating the CoE's process improvements into the daily routine of manufacturing floor managers.
Develop a regulatory compliance matrix for all digital components and new market segments to ensure 'High' regulation adherence before product launch.

key_weaknesses: Operational execution velocity still varies significantly across departments, risking scalability of improvements.
System integration remains a gap; siloed data points between core systems limit 360-degree customer/process visibility.
The company has not yet crystallized whether its growth focus is deep vertical specialization or broad horizontal diversification.

improvements: Successfully implemented cloud ERP migration, establishing a modern operational backbone.
Established a functional data warehouse and BI self-service capability, enhancing data accessibility.
Realized substantial annualized cost savings (€2.4M+) through automation initiatives.
persistent_gaps: Translating centralized data/process improvements into standardized, mandatory floor execution processes requires cultural change management.
Difficulty in leveraging new digital capabilities (AI/ML) due to reliance on improving underlying system integration layers.
The strategic decision point (deep vertical vs. broad horizontal growth) remains undefined.
achieved_milestones: Completion of major core system migrations (ERP, CRM).
Demonstrated successful deployment of RPA/low-code tools for cost reduction.
Formalization of innovation processes via the Transformation Office.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Significant improvement in foundational infrastructure (ERP migration, data warehouse) and operational maturity (CoE establishment), transitioning the company from early-stage formalization to execution scaling.
